_note: Settings each model's live API accepts that muapi's Studio app definitions leave out or cut short. Keyed by the model an app runs on. A key already in the app is widened (same default when still allowed); a new key is added after the app's own settings. src/test/muapi-app-model-controls.test.js checks every entry against src/lib/muapi/liveModels.json and every app setting against the live catalog's declared fields. Left out on purpose: seed, negative prompt and audio (none of these models declares them), and Seedance 2 Resolution / High bitrate / the 4-15 s duration range (the live seedance-2-image-to-video endpoint declares only aspect_ratio and duration; higher resolutions are separate -1080p / -4k endpoints at a higher price).
